items.title: Health score still combines governed and automated assessment models
items.rationale: Preserve explainability while converging toward fully evidence-derived domain scores.

items.title: Runtime benchmark collection is not yet automated against a live Home Assistant test environment
items.rationale: The repository can validate reports but cannot create trustworthy runtime measurements without an execution environment.

items.title: Publication validation requires external GitHub and HACS lifecycle execution
items.rationale: Static repository checks cannot prove external install, update and rollback behavior.
